note: Twin of cli_scope/schema-reference and cli_scope/schema-holdings: a register's columns per scope, one row per delivered representation. Holdings keeps the held variables only and clips each to its held periods, merging the day-adjacent 2018 and 2019 tables into one window. Holdings with a period clips the merged window to the requested year. Fails if holdings stops clipping or merging, stops clipping to the request, a period stops filtering by overlap, or a row loses a field of the CLI's column row.
